_comment: menu.html dish cards, grouped by course. `image` is the source filename in assets/images/; srcset and dimensions are generated from the image manifest at build time. `veg` renders the green vegetarian marker.

dishes.name: Puttu & Kadala
dishes.description: Steamed rice-and-coconut cylinders with a black chickpea curry - the classic Malabar start to the day.

dishes.name: Appam & Stew
dishes.description: Lace-edged fermented rice hoppers with a mild coconut-milk vegetable stew.

dishes.name: Idiyappam
dishes.description: Soft steamed rice string-hoppers, eaten with sweetened coconut milk or curry.

dishes.name: Banana Flower Cutlet
dishes.description: Banana flower cutlet, delicately spiced and fried golden, a rustic Kerala savoury perfect with a warm cup of tea.

dishes.name: Kerala rice sadya
dishes.description: Red parboiled rice with a rotating spread of seasonal vegetable curries served on a plantain leaf.

dishes.name: Biriyani
dishes.description: Fragrant basmati rice layered with tender chicken and warm spices, slow cooked to bring together the flavours of a traditional Malabar kitchen.

dishes.name: Gee Rice Chicken Curry / Casunet curry
dishes.description: Fragrant ghee rice served with tender chicken simmered in a rich, gently spiced curry, a comforting Malabar classic made for a hearty meal.

dishes.name: Dhal, Rice, and Fish Curry
dishes.description: Warm rice served with creamy dal and a traditional Kerala fish curry, a simple homestyle meal full of comforting flavours.

dishes.name: Kappa and Fish Curry
dishes.description: Soft cassava served with a traditional Kerala fish curry, a rustic combination of earthy flavours and gentle spice.

dishes.name: Mutton Biriyani
dishes.description: Tender mutton layered with fragrant rice and warm spices, slow cooked to create a rich and comforting Malabar classic.

dishes.name: Ari Unda
dishes.description: Roasted rice and coconut shaped into little bites, a simple traditional Kerala snack with a gentle sweetness.

dishes.name: Chakka Pappadam
dishes.description: Ripe jackfruit blended with traditional spices and crisp fried, a light and crunchy Kerala snack with a hint of sweetness.

dishes.name: Ada
dishes.description: Delicate rice parcels filled with sweet coconut and jaggery, gently steamed to create a soft and comforting traditional Kerala treat.

dishes.name: Chakka Pradhaman
dishes.description: Ripe jackfruit slow cooked with jaggery and coconut milk, a rich and comforting Kerala dessert with a deep, natural sweetness.

dishes.name: Palada payasam
dishes.description: Slow-cooked milk payasam with rice ada, delicately sweet.

dishes.name: Pazham Pradhaman
dishes.description: Ripe banana slow cooked with jaggery and coconut milk, a rich and traditional Kerala dessert with a warm, natural sweetness.
